name: SOC Lab Wazuh alert approval

steps.action: Reject unexpected fields and non-training Wazuh rule IDs
Read local Wazuh agent and rule context without external secrets
Create a training incident with ATT&CK and telemetry evidence
Use Shuffle User Input to require explicit analyst approval
Call the local allowlisted response endpoint only after approval
Record requester, approver, action, result and rollback time
